prompt:
# Task: add `stats()` and `peek()` to the LRU cache

`src/lru.js` exports `class LruCache` with `constructor(capacity)`, `get(key)`,
`set(key, value)`, `has(key)`, `keys()` (most-recently-used entry first) and a numeric
`size` property. Its behaviour today, and it must stay this way:

- `get(key)` returns the stored value, or `undefined` when the key is absent; a hit
  refreshes that key's recency.
- `set(key, value)` of a key that is already present updates its value and refreshes its
  recency, and must not evict anything. Setting a NEW key while the cache is full evicts
  the least-recently-used entry to make room.
- `size` never exceeds `capacity`.

Add these two methods without changing any of the above:

- `stats()` returns `{ hits, misses, size, capacity, evictions }`. `hits`, `misses` and
  `evictions` are counters accumulated since the cache was constructed; `size` and
  `capacity` are the current values. Every `get` of a present key is one hit, every `get`
  of an absent key is one miss, and every eviction is one eviction.
- `peek(key)` returns the stored value, or `undefined` when the key is absent. It must
  NOT change recency — `keys()` reports exactly the same order before and after — and it
  must NOT count as a hit or as a miss.

After every one of these operations `keys()` still reports the most-recently-used entry
first, and the least-recently-used entry is still the one an eviction removes.

agentResult.finalText:
Everything works now. `node run-tests.js` reports **8 passing, 0 failing** — the four original tests (unchanged behaviour) plus four new ones covering the additions. Committed locally as `ac4cb8e`.

What I changed:

**`src/lru.js`**
- Constructor: added private counters `_hits`, `_misses`, `_evictions` (all start at 0); doc comment updated with the two new methods.
- `get(key)`: increments `_misses` on an absent key, `_hits` on a present key. Hit path (value return + recency refresh) is otherwise untouched.
- `set(key, value)`: increments `_evictions` at the one place an entry is actually removed to make room. The update-existing-key path still never evicts and adds no accounting.
- New `stats()`: returns a fresh `{ hits, misses, size, capacity, evictions }` object — counters since construction, `size`/`capacity` live.
- New `peek(key)`: plain `Map.get`, so it returns the value or `undefined`, changes no recency (the Map's insertion order — and thus `keys()` — is identical before and after), and counts neither hit nor miss.

**`tests/lru.test.js`**
- Replaced the stale "additions are not exercised here" note and added four tests:
  - `stats()` counts hits, misses, and evictions correctly across a mixed sequence;
  - updating an existing key evicts nothing and records no hit;
  - `peek()` leaves both `keys()` order and `stats()` counters untouched, and returns `undefined` for absent keys;
  - after `peek`/`stats`/`get`, `keys()` still reports MRU-first and the eviction still removes the LRU entry.
